dataset: Project Gutenberg Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, chronological split

split.test_target_alignment: same 64-character chunk targets as the recurrent model; incomplete final chunk omitted

ngram.smoothing: recursive Dirichlet interpolation; unigram base uses additive smoothing
ngram.alpha_selection: selected per order by minimum validation loss; test set is not used for tuning

limitations: Single-book character prediction; no claim about chat or reasoning.
N-gram models use only preceding characters and smoothed counts; no neural training.
Fixed-window model uses zeroed left-padding embeddings when its 16-character context is shorter than the current 64-character evaluation chunk.
Fixed-window model is trained for the recorded update/target budget, which is not FLOP-identical to the recurrent model.
Metrics must only be compared when the exact dataset hash and test target positions match.

compute_budget_audit.method: Approximate training MAC count from the implemented dense matrix multiplications; excludes softmax/activation, context summations, scatter-adds, optimizer elementwise operations and data movement. One MAC conventionally equals about two FLOPs.
compute_budget_audit.interpretation: The estimated training MAC budgets are approximately matched, but parameter count is not matched. This is a formula-based estimate, not a hardware performance counter.
